test_command: dotnet build api/Biolog.Api/Biolog.Api.csproj && dotnet test tests/features/bio-vis-001/Biolog.Features.Visitors.Tests.csproj && dotnet test tests/dotnet/Biolog.IntegrationTests/Biolog.IntegrationTests.csproj && bash tests/features/bio-vis-001/BIO-VIS-001.test.sh && bash scripts/quality.sh
notes:
Implements BIO-VIS-001 (visitor preregistration and host approval) as a direct structural sibling of BIO-ATT-001: VisitorRecord (mutable, CAS-versioned, PERSON-lifecycle-shaped aggregate, internal constructor/mutation methods, per-record lock, dual-boundary transition validation) carries an optional PersonId link (AC01 - a lead needs no permanent identity; a repeat visitor can be linked), a required HostPersonId (both existence-gated against BIO-IDN-001, no lifecycle check - a visitor record is a fact capture, same disclosed boundary BIO-ATT-001 recorded for its own person gateway), a Pending/Approved/Denied HostApprovalStatus decided exactly once with every transition audited (AC02), and the AC03 configurable-evidence fields (vehicle plate, NDA acceptance, safety briefing, watchlist screening result, temporary credential requested/issued). VisitorTenantConfig (CAS-versioned, mirrors AttendancePolicy exactly) makes each of the four Require* fields and AllowTemporaryCredential independently configurable per tenant, enforced at CHECK-IN time (not preregistration - a visitor preregisters first, satisfies requirements before arrival) by VisitorRecordService.CheckInAsync. One proactive, non-configurable safety rule: a Flagged watchlist result blocks check-in unconditionally regardless of config. AC04's automatic expiry is computed at read time only (VisitorStatusEvaluator.EffectiveStatus, a pure function returning a genuinely distinct enum type EffectiveVisitStatus with an Expired member the persisted VisitStatus can never hold) - the same BIO-IDN-002/BIO-ATT-001 'refuse auto-flip, compute in effect at read time' discipline, never auto-mutating the stored record.

ADR-0006 Decision 1/2 re-derived fresh (not pattern-matched from BIO-ACC-001's access-policy precedent, per its own QA-01 lesson): preregistration/read/check-in/check-out/evidence-capture (NDA/safety-briefing/watchlist-result/temporary-credential) stay open to any asserted actor, audit-attribution only - visitor contact/vehicle/watchlist data is comparable sensitivity to BIO-ATT-001's own presence data and PERSON's name/DOB, not to access-policy rule content. Approve/Deny (VisitorRecordService.DecidePermission = 'visitor.approve') and VisitorConfigService.SetAsync ('visitor.config_manage') are this feature's two authorization decisions - gated by permission via IPermissionGateway (wrapping BIO-IDN-006's PermissionService) AND a verified ADR-0006 Decision 3 provenance proof (ActorProvenanceGate, hand-ported feature-locally exactly as BIO-ACC-001/BIO-ATT-001's own).

No canonical vis_ identifier prefix minted: contracts/schemas/identifier-registry.json is Kemi-owned (ADR-0001 Decision 1, 'adding or changing an entry requires an amending ADR and recorded Kemi approval') and has no visitor entry. Rather than requesting a new registry type unilaterally, followed BIO-ACC-001's own disclosed precedent for the identical situation (it keyed AccessPolicy by a business PolicyKey instead of minting a new type) - VisitorRecord.Id is a plain, undecorated Guid.CreateVersion7() string, never vis_-prefixed, documented in docs/features/bio-vis-001/README.md 'Why VisitorRecord has no canonical id prefix'.

AC05: web/features/visitors/{visitors-page.tsx,ports.ts,mock.ts} completely untouched (harness-enforced, BIO-VIS-001.test.sh greps for zero BIO-VIS-001 mentions in those three files) - no unapproved UI redesign. live.ts already existed as BIO-UX-005/010 scaffolding POSTing headerless requests to three fixed routes (primary-action/check-out-visitor/view-visit-history); this story adds the real Biolog.Api endpoints those routes resolve to, backed by VisitorDemoBridgeService (Singleton, exercises genuine domain preregister->auto-approve->check-in/check-out logic against three fixed synthetic demo visitors, not a canned string - same AC05 pattern BIO-ATT-001's own AttendanceDemoBridgeService established). Demo tenant id reuses the literal 'tenant' example contracts/schemas/identifier-registry.json itself publishes (same value BIO-ATT-001's bridge already uses, no collision risk - completely separate repository). Documented HYBRID precisely: full preregistration/approval/config domain model is real and LIVE-reachable; the page's own displayed visitor list stays synthetic-data-sourced since no preregistration/approval UI exists yet in the approved page.

Quality gate: added this story's own harness/unit-test/vulnerability-audit lines to scripts/quality.sh (same convention every prior story followed) - a first quality.sh run (pre-dating these additions) passed clean (exit 0, no regressions from this story's presence); a second full run with the new lines wired in also passed clean (exit 0, QUALITY: PASS). A pre-existing, disclosed flake unrelated to this story - Biolog.IntegrationTests.ObservabilityTests.AC01_a (owned by BIO-FND-008) - intermittently fails under xUnit parallel execution due to a global Console.Out redirection race (observed twice with two different exception shapes at the same line, the signature of a data race); confirmed via isolation (9/9 clean alone) and a subsequent clean 146/146 full run. Documented in docs/features/bio-vis-001/README.md, not touched (outside this story's write scope).

Verified: dotnet build clean (api/Biolog.Api/Biolog.Api.csproj), 25/25 feature unit tests (Biolog.Features.Visitors.Tests, including a genuine 20-way concurrent-approve race proving only one caller's CAS wins), 6/6 new real-host VisitorHostChannelTests (preregistration reaching the real BIO-IDN-001 gateway, unknown-host rejection, approve/config rejected for lack of authority, approve rejected for missing provenance, the three headerless AC05 bridge routes), full Biolog.IntegrationTests suite 146/146 (aside from the disclosed pre-existing flake above), 31/31 BIO-VIS-001.test.sh structural checks, scripts/quality.sh QUALITY PASS (module-reference-direction PASS, traceability inventory PASS at 31 implemented stories, secret-scan clean).
